body:
Armor the integration against upstream drift (opencode releases near-daily; CI currently pins 1.17.13 while upstream is 1.17.17). Full context: docs/specs/opencode-integration-continuation.md §T-C.

=== WORK ITEMS ===
1. CI version matrix for the live proofs (scripts/opencode-live-deny.mjs and scripts/opencode-live-tool.mjs in .github/workflows/ci.yml): run against BOTH the pinned floor (opencode-ai@1.17.13, the version whose hook contract the enforce-by-default posture was verified against) and opencode-ai@latest. The latest job is ADVISORY (continue-on-error: true + a visible job name) so upstream churn cannot block unrelated merges, but drift surfaces same-day.
2. Reference sweep: the upstream repo moved github.com/sst/opencode → github.com/anomalyco/opencode. Update every reference in docs/, plugins/adlc-opencode/, ADRs, and code comments. grep -r "sst/opencode" must return zero hits.
3. Re-verify permission.ask dormancy: upstream issue #7006 said the hook is defined but never dispatched at 1.17.13. Test against 1.17.17 (extend scripts/opencode-live-deny.mjs or a sibling probe: register a permission.ask handler, trigger a permission, observe dispatch). If now dispatched: promote the dormant handler in plugins/adlc-opencode/index.mjs to a live-tested second lever and record the activation. Either way, record the dated finding in docs/adr/0004-adlc-opencode-integration.md.
4. Bump the verified-against note in docs/integrations/opencode.md and the peerDependencies floor rationale if the probe changes posture.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
AC1: ci.yml contains both pinned and latest live-proof runs; latest is advisory (verify: read the workflow; both jobs present with the pinned one required).
AC2: zero sst/opencode references (verify: grep -rn "sst/opencode" --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git returns nothing).
AC3: ADR 0004 has a dated permission.ask status entry citing the 1.17.17 probe result (verify: read ADR).
AC4: full test suite green (verify: npm test exits 0).
title: OpenCode upstream sync: 1.17.17 baseline, CI live-proof version matrix, anomalyco sweep, permission.ask re-check
